title: Source-based repository audit workflow
summary: Guide a reviewer through the human README journey and the coding-agent entry point, then capture findings, evidence, and verification gaps at a pinned repository revision.
acceptance_criteria: The published workflow guides reviewers to a full target SHA, the README, real entry points, rules, and checks.
A completed review records reader impact, severity, source references, execution status, and gaps.

evidence.claim: The published audit guide documents the process and finding format.
The published portfolio audit provides an example of the workflow.
